question: Compare a process and a thread.

answers.text: Processes normally have separate address spaces. Threads in one process share its address space but have their own stacks and registers. Shared mutable state needs synchronization.
answers.label: strong

answers.text: I would identify the shared mutable state, protect the entire read-modify-write operation with a mutex, and test for lost updates. Lock contention can limit throughput, so I would profile it before changing the design.
answers.label: strong
